description: Validation gates. A strategy must pass ALL required gates before it may be scored live on the leaderboard or used for any decision. Gates exist to remove luck from results and to make skill measurable.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.rule: Every input used by the strategy must carry a source link to an official/trusted source and a fetch date. Unverified inputs are forbidden.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Strategy definition, markets, and selection rules are timestamped and frozen BEFORE outcomes are observed. No retro edits.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Minimum settled picks per market type before scoring.
gates.threshold: singles n>=200; parlays n>=100; prop combos n>=100

gates.name: Walk-forward validation
gates.rule: Fit/choose on past windows, test on strictly later windows. Rolling re-fit only.
gates.status: not met - historical odds archive missing (Q-03)

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.rule: When many signals/parameter variants are tried, significance is judged with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 on the final candidate set.

gates.name: Closing line value (CLV)
gates.rule: Median CLV per pick must be > 0 with sign test p<0.05 vs break-even at recorded prices.
gates.status: tracking started (odds opens vs current captured 2026-11-14)

gates.name: Vig-adjusted break-even
gates.rule: ROI must clear break-even at the prices actually taken (e.g. -110 needs 52.38%), with Wilson 95% CI lower bound > break-even.

gates.name: Luck removal
gates.rule: (a) Bayesian shrinkage of win% toward 0.5 with beta(1,1) prior reported alongside raw record; (b) binomial test vs break-even at 95%; (c) deflated Sharpe ratio > 1.0 after accounting for the number of attempted strategies.
gates.status: policy ready; luck.json provides the regression lens for team-level signals

gates.name: Correlation integrity
gates.rule: Every parlay/prop-combo leg pair must have a measured correlation from validated data. |r|>=0.3 requires explicit dependency modeling; unmeasured pairs are forbidden.
gates.status: not met - pilot values only (correlation.json, F-08)

notes: No strategy in strategies.json has passed any gate yet. The leaderboard therefore holds zero live entries by design.
Gate status is re-evaluated weekly; nothing is marked verified without a linked source.
